name: B10-0423/2026 – § 7 – Am 9
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: 7. Calls for stricter and more harmonised rules on revolving doors, including adequate cooling-off periods, clear rules and transparency requirements regarding secondary paid activities carried out by Members of Parliament, and clearer rules on lobbying and the representation of private interests related to previous public functions; calls, in order to limit potential conflicts of interest, for a ban on secondary paid activities carried out by Members of the European Parliament, or on activities undertaken on behalf of organisations or individuals falling within the scope of the transparency register;
